scope: Partial four-spell lifecycle/casting checkpoint, not all-seven ability qualification or TAC-10 acceptance
actualReview:
**No concrete blocker found in this four-spell checkpoint.** It supports the reported casting and effect continuation in the Ferry epoch; **TAC-10 remains unaccepted**.

The retained records reconcile with the source:

- Ward, Guidance, Detect and Dispel use actual Ferry Starts **2/5/8/11**, each spending its current Action and recording exactly one magical casting End. RP follows **7→7→7→5→2**; final Dissonance2 is consistent with the two ranked casts and no idle-turn reduction.
- Ward expires at its original next caster Start5. Guidance remains present when Detect begins and is dispelled before its60-second deadline.
- Dispel’s command uses the publicly discovered opaque aura token. The implementation revalidates active Detect, current perception and the companion’s original rank0 Guidance provenance. The retained transaction ends that Guidance effect while preserving Detect.
- These four casts consume no RNG. The intervening creature attack accounts for the changed RNG state before Dispel; the entire branch is not RNG-free.

I independently checked the [committed packet](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/4a79a45a14817d6ddee98c099b5ef661de01b598/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-16-tac10-ferry-wraith-runtime/CASTING_CHECKPOINT.md), including:

- Archive length/hash and **all14 member lengths/hashes**.
- Executed driver bytes, original r351 save membership, **468 compilation-input hashes**, build-report identity and the **three loaded runtime DLL bindings**.
- All27 contiguous command/receipt pairs, four cast records and matching Ends, intermediate saves and final byte-identical save pair.
- Independent binary checksum/header/actor/receipt/clock/RNG extraction; the four pinned operational procedures; and reproduction of the aura token from its retained binding.
- Relevant source and driver assertions, supplemented by a separate read-only source review.

**Coverage precision:** this branch demonstrates Ward activation/expiry and Guidance’s lifecycle as the selected Dispel target. It does not independently isolate Ward’s AC contribution or exercise Guidance’s check consumption. Repeated-spell Refrain, adverse casting boundaries and broader consumer qualification also remain open.

**I did not compile, execute C#/PowerShell, perform engine restores or causal replay, or observe workers.** Those remain Codex’s retained executions.

Continue the approved same-module work. The remaining abilities, combat interactions, boundary/privacy/forgery checks, consumer audit, complete regression, five paths, compatibility and final review remain mandatory. Main r462 still has3RP; the4RP successor example remains unfunded. No successor authorization; Unity deferred, storage/Support held.
codexAgreement: Agree that no concrete blocker remains in this bounded four-spell lifecycle checkpoint. Ward AC contribution, Guidance check consumption, repeated-spell Refrain, adverse casting boundaries and broader consumer qualification are not independently proved by this branch. The four casts consume no RNG; the intervening actual creature attack does. Continue the same TAC-10 module; no successor or whole-engine completion claim.
